app.name: Unfathomable Companion
app.reset.confirm: Start a new game? Characters, titles and statuses are cleared; game settings are kept.
app.footer: Unofficial fan aid, not affiliated with Fantasy Flight Games
setup.locked: The game is in play, so setup is locked. Track titles and the Brig on {roles}, or {unlock}.
setup.locked.unlockConfirm: Go back to setup? Titles, Brig and traitor statuses are cleared.
setup.abyss.hint: Expansion: 8 more characters, horrors and allies.
setup.noCultist.hint: 4 and 6 players: a Human card replaces the Cultist, and the dials start lower.
setup.preludes.hint: Shuffle and draw prelude cards in the app; the Preludes section opens just below.
setup.characters.hint: Tap the characters in play ({min}–{max} players). Any character can be chosen.
setup.needPlayers: Choose {min} to {max} characters to see the loyalty deck and starting titles.
setup.loyalty.deal: Shuffle the {size} cards and deal 1 to each player now. The other {players} are dealt at the awakening phase, when the waypoints in play reach 6 distance.
setup.loyalty.cultist: The Cultist is a traitor who only wins if the ship has traveled 12 or more distance when the Deep Ones win. With a Hybrid card as well, they win as a Hybrid.
setup.loyalty.noCultist: No-Cultist variant: the Cultist is replaced by a Human card.
log.awakening: Awakening phase: second loyalty card dealt
roles.notStarted: Choose the characters on {setup} and start the game to track titles.
roles.revealConfirm: Reveal {name} as a traitor? This can't be undone in the app.
roles.statusHint: Moving to the Brig or revealing loses all titles; they pass to the next human in line who is not in the Brig. Leaving the Brig gives nothing back.
roles.awakening.when: Once per game: after resolving the waypoint card that brings the total distance in play to 6 or more.
roles.awakening.step1: Deal 1 loyalty card to each player (this uses up the loyalty deck).
roles.awakening.step2: Everyone looks at all their loyalty cards at the same time, then puts them facedown.
roles.awakening.step3: Starting with the current player and going clockwise, each revealed traitor gives their new card to a human of their choice.
roles.awakening.done: Done: every player has had a second loyalty card.
roles.reveal.step1: Reveal one Hybrid or Cultist card (your choice if you have both).
roles.reveal.step2: Resolve the “When you reveal as a traitor” ability on your character sheet, then cover the sheet's abilities with the revealed card.
roles.reveal.step3: Traveled less than 12 distance: give each of your unrevealed loyalty cards to another player. 12 or more: keep them facedown.
roles.reveal.step4: Lose all titles (the app passes them on when you tap Reveal).
roles.reveal.step5: Discard any mythos cards in your play area and remove your feat card from the game.
roles.reveal.step6: If you are not in the Brig, you may discard any number of skill cards to draw as many treachery cards.
roles.reveal.step7: Put a revealed-traitor ring on your standee.
roles.reveal.note: Revealing on your own turn: you can still take your remaining actions, but you skip your Mythos step.
roles.brig.rule1: A human is sent there by the Captain's Cabin action (a skill check anyone can add to); a revealed traitor goes there when defeated. Moving there loses all titles.
roles.brig.rule2: Humans get out with the Brig's action (a skill check). Revealed traitors get out by discarding skill cards worth 12 or more at once.
roles.brig.rule3: In the Brig you add at most one skill card to a skill check and can't use item abilities (your Improvement doesn't count).
roles.brig.rule4: Mythos step in the Brig: resolve only the activation and track icons, not the crisis. On a choice-of-track icon the Captain chooses.
roles.brig.rule5: You draw your full skill set when receiving skills and can still use skill card abilities. A defeated player in the Brig stays there.
dice.intro: One eight-sided die. An attack succeeds on the target number or higher.
dice.targetModified: Target {target}+, +{modifier} to the roll: hits on {need}+
dice.humanDeepOne.outcome: Hit: the Deep One returns to the supply.
dice.humanTraitor.outcome: Hit: the traitor moves to the Brig.
dice.traitorHuman.outcome: Hit: the human moves to the Sick Bay (or stays in the Brig).
dice.deepOneHuman.outcome: Hit: the human moves to the Sick Bay (or stays in the Brig). The current player picks the defender.
dice.humanHorror.outcome: Hit: the horror is repelled, not defeated. The attacker moves it to an adjacent space and may discard skill cards worth 4 or more to move it one more.
dice.shoggothHuman: Shoggoth attacks each human in its space
dice.shoggothHuman.outcome: One roll per human. Hit: Sick Bay.
dice.tendrilHuman: Grasping Tendril attacks a human in its deck space
dice.tendrilHuman.outcome: Hit: Sick Bay. Then the Tendril moves 1 space toward the front of the ship.
dice.cannotAttack: The attacker must share a space with the defender. Monarchs (Mother Hydra, Father Dagon) can't be attacked. Deep Ones never attack revealed traitors.
dice.cannotAttackAbyss: The attacker must share a space with the defender. Monarchs (Mother Hydra, Father Dagon) can't be attacked. Deep Ones never attack revealed traitors. Horrors are only ever repelled; only the travel and ritual tracks remove them.
dice.steps.step1: Attacker: the player or Deep One attacking.
dice.steps.step2: Defender: chosen by the attacking player, or by the current player for a Deep One.
dice.steps.step3: Target number: 4 against a Deep One, 6 against a character.
dice.steps.step4: Use any “before a die is rolled” abilities.
dice.steps.step6: Use any reroll abilities; after a reroll, go back to step 4.
dice.steps.step7: Result plus modifiers ≥ target: the defender is defeated. Otherwise nothing happens.
dice.rules.clamp: Modifiers can't take a result below 1 or above 8.
dice.rules.reroll: Modifiers to the first roll also apply to a reroll.
dice.rules.once: “Limit once per die roll” abilities work once, however many rerolls there are.
dice.other.deep.result: With 4+ Deep Ones in the Deep: all monsters there go to the matching water space
dice.other.risk.result: A passenger appears in the matching deck space
dice.other.tendril.result: Matching water space (and the deck space next to it)
dice.other.wander.result: A different space matching the roll; the player who used it picks deck or interior
dice.other.allies.result: Roll twice, rerolling a repeat: one ally in each matching interior space
monsters.intro: Tap the activation icon on the mythos card you drew. When a crisis shows several icons, tap them in order, left to right.
monsters.mythos.track: Track icon (lower right): advance that track one space.
monsters.track.travel: Travel track. Each space advanced moves every monster in a water space one space toward the back of the ship (from the back: into the Deep).
monsters.track.ritual: Ritual track. At Cast, the greater banishment spell is cast.
monsters.track.choice: Choice of track: the current player picks; the Captain picks if the current player is in the Brig.
monsters.track.horror: Horror icon (From the Abyss): a track icon only while no horror is on the board.
monsters.mythos.brig: A human in the Brig resolves only the activation and track icons. A character-specific card for a character who is in the Brig, revealed or not in the game is discarded and redrawn.
monsters.repel.rule1: A horror that would be defeated is repelled instead: moved to an adjacent space, plus one more if that player discards skill cards worth 4 or more.
monsters.repel.rule2: Who repels: the attacker; the player who used the card ability; for a mythos card, the player who made the choice, otherwise the current player.
monsters.repel.rule3: Only the tracks remove horrors: the travel track pushes horrors in water spaces toward the back (defeated if already at the back), and the ritual track reaching Cast defeats each horror in a deck or water space.
monsters.repel.rule4: No space actions where a horror is. Horrors never enter the Brig or Sick Bay. When the last horror leaves the board, the horror token goes back to Start.
activation.firstOption: It does the first of these it can:
activation.deepOnes.name: Deep Ones
activation.deepOnes.intro: Every Deep One on the board activates, one at a time, in the order the current player chooses. Deep Ones in the Deep don't activate.
activation.deepOnes.option1: Attack a human in its space (the current player picks which). Never a revealed traitor.
activation.deepOnes.option3: Damage its space, if it is an undamaged interior space (draw a damage card).
activation.deepOnes.option4: Move: in a water or deck space, follow the movement arrow; in an interior space, go toward the closest undamaged interior space (highest number on a tie).
activation.deepOnes.note: No Deep Ones on the board (the Deep doesn't count): spawn 2 Deep Ones in the Deep instead. If 4 or more are there now, roll the die and move every monster in the Deep to the matching water space. Not enough Deep Ones to spawn: the game ends.
activation.fatherDagon.name: Father Dagon
activation.fatherDagon.step1: Spawn 2 Deep Ones in the deck space his movement arrow points to.
activation.fatherDagon.step2: Move 1 water space toward the front of the ship (not if he is already in a numbered water space).
activation.fatherDagon.note: In the Deep: spawn 2 Deep Ones in the Deep instead. If 4 or more are there now, roll the die and move him and all Deep Ones in the Deep to the matching water space. Not enough Deep Ones to spawn: the game ends.
activation.motherHydra.name: Mother Hydra
activation.motherHydra.step1: Damage the interior space closest to her (follow the movement arrows). If it is already damaged, damage the undamaged interior space closest to it (highest number on a tie). Six damaged spaces at once: the game ends.
activation.motherHydra.step2: Move 1 water space toward the front of the ship (not if she is already in a numbered water space).
activation.motherHydra.note: In the Deep: spawn 2 Deep Ones in the Deep instead. If 4 or more are there now, roll the die and move her and all Deep Ones in the Deep to the matching water space. Not enough Deep Ones to spawn: the game ends.
activation.shoggoth.name: Shoggoth
activation.shoggoth.intro: Not on the board? Roll the die and spawn it in the matching deck space. Then, either way:
activation.shoggoth.option1: Attack each human in its space, +1 to each roll.
activation.shoggoth.option3: Damage its space, if it is an undamaged interior space.
activation.shoggoth.option4: Remove the top 4 item cards from the game unseen, then move: water → the adjacent deck space; deck → the adjacent interior space; interior → toward the closest undamaged interior space (highest number on a tie).
activation.shoggoth.note: Fewer than 4 item cards left: remove what there is, then move as normal.
activation.drownedSpirit.name: Drowned Spirit
activation.drownedSpirit.intro: Not on the board? Roll the die and spawn it in the matching interior space. Then, either way:
activation.drownedSpirit.option1: Damage its space, if it is an undamaged interior space.
activation.drownedSpirit.option2: Remove the top 4 spell cards from the game unseen, then move: water → the adjacent deck space; deck → the adjacent interior space; interior → toward the closest undamaged interior space (highest number on a tie).
activation.drownedSpirit.note: Fewer than 4 spell cards left: remove what there is, then move as normal.
activation.graspingTendril.name: Grasping Tendril
activation.graspingTendril.intro: It occupies a water space and the deck space next to it. Not on the board? Roll the die and spawn it in the matching water space. Then, either way:
activation.graspingTendril.option1: Attack a human in its deck space, +1 to the roll. Then move 1 space toward the front of the ship.
activation.graspingTendril.option2: Move each passenger from its deck space to its water space. Then move 1 space toward the front of the ship.
activation.graspingTendril.option3: Spawn 1 passenger in its water space. Then move 1 space toward the front of the ship.
activation.graspingTendril.note: No passengers left to spawn: it still moves.
activation.horror.name: Horror icon
activation.horror.none: It works as a track icon: advance the horror token one space on the horror track. When it reaches Spawn, set the token aside, draw the top horror card and resolve it (usually it resolves that horror's activation icon, spawning it).
activation.horror.many: Flip cards from the top of the horror deck until one names a horror on the board. That horror activates. Shuffle all the flipped cards back into the horror deck.
rules.noResults: Nothing in the rules matches that.
rules.source: Text of the Unfathomable Rules Reference (v5): the glossary and appendices I–III.
rules.scope.core: Core rules only. Turn on From the Abyss on {setup} to add the expansion's chapters and its changes to these rules.
rules.scope.abyss: With From the Abyss: rules it changes or adds are marked, and its own chapters follow the appendices. Change this on {setup}.
rules.source.abyss: Text of the Unfathomable Rules Reference (v5), glossary and appendices I–III, with the From the Abyss rulebook.
setup.start.delegate: Delegate Authority: each title starts with the character next-highest in its line of succession.
preludes.title: Preludes
preludes.intro: Prelude cards change the starting state of the game. Choose how many of each kind to use, then let the app shuffle and draw them for you. Day cards favour the humans, twilight cards affect everyone, night cards favour the hybrids.
preludes.balance: Standard is one of each. The book lets everyone agree to swap night for twilight or twilight for day (favour humans), the other way round (favour hybrids), or draw extra cards of any kind.
preludes.pool.hint: Tap a card to leave it out of the draw, or to put it back.
preludes.notEnough: Not enough cards left in: {types}. Put cards back or draw fewer.
preludes.resolve: Resolve them in this order: day, then twilight, then night. Read each one aloud, then resolve it.
preludes.keep: Keep this card by the mythos deck until the first Mythos step.
preludes.delegateApplied: The app hands out the starting titles this way when you start the game.
preludes.after: Then remove all prelude cards from the game (except Respite, which waits for the first Mythos step).
preludes.step.mix: Choose how many of each kind
preludes.none: Choose at least one card above.
preludes.stale: These were drawn with a different choice ({mix}). Tap the button above to draw again with your new choice.
preludes.noneDrawn: No preludes were drawn for this game.
about.disclaimer.title: Unofficial fan project
about.disclaimer: Unfathomable Companion is an unofficial, non-commercial fan aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored or approved by Fantasy Flight Games or Asmodee.
about.art: The artwork is not my own. The character portraits, prelude cards, icons and other game imagery, and the rules text, come from Unfathomable and From the Abyss and belong to their owners. They are shown here only as a reference for people playing the game.
about.takedown: Rights holders who want any of this material changed or removed can get in touch through the project's repository.
about.credit.core: Game design by Tony Fanchi, based on game design by Corey Konieczka. TM/® & © 2021 Fantasy Flight Games.
about.credit.abyss: Expansion design and development by Alexandar Ortloff-Tang. TM/® & © 2024 Fantasy Flight Games.
about.material.rules: Rules text from the Unfathomable Rules Reference and the From the Abyss rulebook, and the prelude card text.
about.material.art: Character portraits, prelude card images, and activation, track, resource and skill icons, cut from the game's cards and reference sheets.
about.material.names: Game, character and card names, and the lines of succession.
about.licence.text: The app's own code and design are released under the MIT licence: you may reuse, change and share them freely, keeping the copyright notice. The licence does not cover the game material listed above, which is not mine to license.
about.privacy: The app has no accounts and sends nothing anywhere: your game is saved only on this device.
about.credit.federant: By Cyreal. Headings, standing in for the rulebook's Secession typeface.
about.credit.garamond: By the EB Garamond Project Authors. Body text, standing in for Arno Pro.
about.credit.fontsource: Self-hosted font packages, so the app works offline.
about.licences.note: The open-source software and fonts bundled in this app are distributed under the MIT and SIL Open Font licences; their full texts are included with the app.
about.credit.capacitor: The iOS and Android apps (with @capacitor/app, /preferences and /splash-screen).
